Date June 13 1940

Subject (in full) American Citizens wanted by United States Consulate

Made by D. S. Hocking Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

Further to the attached report concerning
two American seamen, L.D. Morgan and T.H. Curry,
these two men together with two other undesirable
American Citizens named McGuinn and O'Callaghan,
left Shanghai on June 5, 1940, aboard the s.s.
"City of Jolliet", bound for Australia via Manila.
Mr. Vyse of the American Consulate completed all
arrangements for their departure.

E 13/6

D. S. Hocking
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch)

R.S. / 13/6

REPORT
〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写批注〕
Date May 25, 1940.

Subject. American Citizens wanted by United States Consulate.

Made by. D. S. Hocking, Forwarded by. D.I. Crawford.

With reference to the attached request from
the U.S. Marshal for China that the two men, L.D.
Morgan and P.H. Curry, be advised to call on Mr.
Vyse of the American Consulate, I have to report
that no direct contact has been made with these men.
It is known that they are still in Shanghai
and among places they are often seen are the
entrance to the Navy Y.M.C.A. on Szechuen Road,
the Salvation Army Shelter on Muirhead Road, the
Silver $ Bar on Rue Chu Pao San and on occasion
the office of the Mission to Seaman, 2 Peking Road.
Word has been left at these places that Mr. Vyse
would like to see them at the earliest opportunity.

D.S. Hocking
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch).

〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写批注〕
日期 1940年5月25日。

事由。 美国领事馆通缉的美国公民。

撰写人。 D. S. Hocking， 转呈人。 D.I. Crawford。

关于随函附上的驻华美国法警要求通知 L.D. Morgan 和 P.H. Curry 二人去拜访美国领事馆 Vyse 先生的请求，本人须报告称，尚未与这些人取得直接联系。已知他们仍身处上海，常被人见到的地点包括四川路海军青年会（Navy Y.M.C.A.）入口处、穆尔黑德路（Muirhead Road）救世军收容所、朱葆三路（Rue Chu Pao San）的 Silver $ Bar 酒吧，以及偶尔在北京路2号的海员传教会（Mission to Seaman）办公室。已在这些地方留下口信，称 Vyse 先生希望尽早见到他们。

D.S. Hocking
D. S.

副总监（特别科）。

DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE
U. S. MARSHAL FOR CHINA
SHANGHAI, CHINA
May 6, 1940

〔此处转录不清〕

9998
5 140

Commissioner of Police,
Central Station,
Shanghai.

Sir:

It is requested that Lawrence Deloss Morgan
and Theodore Harry Curry, two American seamen who
have been engaged in questionable activities about
Shanghai, be notified that they are wanted by Mr.
Wyse of the American Consulate.

It will not be necessary to take these men
into custody; we are only desirous that they be
notified.

Very truly yours,

Gordon Campbell
Gordon Campbell,
U. S. Marshal for China.

警察总监，
中央捕房，
上海。

先生：

兹请通知 Lawrence Deloss Morgan 和 Theodore Harry Curry 两名美国海员，美国领事馆 Wyse 先生欲见他们；此二人在上海一带从事可疑活动。

无需将此二人拘留；我方仅希望通知他们。

此致，

Gordon Campbell
Gordon Campbell，
驻华美国法警。

致驻华美国法警。
